thread:
sam: Customer Gamma asked for a crisp GA offer vs a committed low-latency add-on. need clear go/no-go checklist.

nina: propose two tracks: GA-prod = 99.9% uptime + published perf matrix; Committed-add-on = reserved pools + 99.95% + p95 target.

carlos: tech realities: multi-tenant hosted can't guarantee 50ms p95 without dedicated scheduling and model pinning. estimate 3w cross-team to implement safe reserved scheduling.

emma: docs/SDK must show how to opt into region+pinned model and include onboarding checklist. I can draft samples in 4 business days.

finance: pricing note: reserved capacity carries blocking cost. recommend minimum commitment + uplift (approx +30-40%).

ops-bot: runbook created: "committed-capacity-onboard" (link: https://phab/runbooks/committed-capacity).

sam: suggested prod-entry criteria:
- perf matrix published by model/sequence
- per-route telemetry live
- legal approved GA wording
- support TATs defined

nina: committed-add-on criteria:
- reserved scheduling & quota enforcement implemented
- per-tenant latency & kv-hit metrics emitted
- 14d soak test passing
- pricing & contract template signed off

carlos: actions: spec owner = carlos (ETA 2026-04-11), scheduler work = carlos+infra (ETA 2026-04-20), metrics = ops (ETA 2026-04-09), docs = emma (ETA 2026-04-07), pricing = finance (ETA 2026-04-06).

sam: I'll draft the customer response: outline GA baseline and committed path with required commitments. will share for review.

emma: note: add pre-warm API example to onboarding docs. saves cold-start tails.

finance: I'll produce the uplift & minimum term proposal and circulate.

sam: thanks all. keep updates here and we'll review in Friday sync. :thumbsup:
